stem.text: Which compound has the molecular formula $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclopentanone ring with a C=O group and a methyl substituent

B.alt: Skeletal formula: ketone with a C=O group and a branched carbon skeleton

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexenone, a six-membered ring with a C=O group and a C=C bond

D.alt: Skeletal formula: branched alkene with a terminal C=CH2 group and a CH2OH group
